script.goal: Book the free 15-minute website check (screen share) and learn her real budget, goals and enquiry numbers. Not to sell on this call.
script.opener: "Hi Lisa, it's [name] from Maximus Mediascape. You filled in our form about digital marketing and lead generation, so I'm following up. Is now an OK time for five minutes? ... Before calling I had a look at your website and Google listing, and there are two or three small things I think could help. First, can I ask what you're hoping marketing will do for the business?"

items: Which services bring in most of your work: kids' parties, marquees, cocktail bars, weddings?
What are your busiest months, and what are you booking now (Christmas, New Year)?
Which areas do you really cover?
About how many enquiries do you get a month, and which ones pay best?
How do people find you today?
When an enquiry comes in, how do you reply and how fast?
About how many turn into bookings?
Do you get reviews, and where?
What does growth mean for you in numbers (bookings a month)?
What have you tried so far (ads, social, directories)?
What would feel comfortable as a one-off amount, or a monthly one?
Who built the website, and who has the hosting and domain logins?
Do you see how many people visit, or where they come from?
Are you on Facebook or Instagram for the business?
Do you have photos from real events and any reviews we could use?
Do you have set prices or packages, and public liability insurance?

objections: That's why we have a one-off Starter: fixed price, split in two, and you own the site. We can start with just the basics. (Confirm the price first.)
You do, and it's a good base. The gaps are small: tap-to-call, titles, reviews and tracking. We can look together at whether to fix it or rebuild.
Great. I can send you the list of what we found so you can compare, free of charge.
Happy to. So I send the right thing: is it more enquiries you need, or less time chasing them?
It's a busy time of year.
Understood. A 15-minute check is enough for now. When is a better week?
How did you get my number?
From the form you filled in on [date and source]. I can remove it if you'd prefer.
script.close: "Could we do a 15-minute screen share this week, where I show you the three things on your own site and we decide whether a proper plan is worth it?"
script.followup: Same day. Thank her for her time, recap the three points we discussed, give the booking link for the 15-minute check, and say there is no obligation. Do not attach prices unless she asked.

rules: She is an inbound lead, so reply fast: call, then send a message within minutes (speed matters; set your own target).
Use the channel she used or gave on the form. Check what the form said about being contacted, and by which channel.
Identify yourself and the company, say where you got her details, and give a simple way to stop.
Each follow-up must add something new. Never send "just checking in".
No prices in the first message unless she asked.
first_touch.whatsapp: Hi Lisa, it's [name] at Maximus Mediascape. Thanks for your enquiry about digital marketing and lead generation. I had a quick look at your website and have two or three simple ideas. When is a good time for a 5-minute call? If you'd rather I didn't message, just reply STOP.
first_touch.voicemail: Hi Lisa, it's [name] from Maximus Mediascape, returning your enquiry about digital marketing. I had a look at your website and have a couple of quick ideas. I'll send you a short message with them. Again, [name], Maximus Mediascape, [number].
first_touch.email_subject: Your enquiry: a few quick ideas for Moments and Memories
first_touch.email_body:
Hi Lisa,

Thanks for getting in touch about digital marketing and lead generation. Before writing I looked at your website and noticed three small things that may be costing you enquiries:

1. Visitors on a phone cannot tap to call or WhatsApp you.
2. In Google, your pages show only your web address as the title.
3. There is no way to see which visits turn into enquiries.

I can walk you through them in a free 15-minute check, no obligation. Would [day] or [day] suit?

[name], Maximus Mediascape, [phone]

You are getting this because you sent us your details through our form on [date]. Reply "remove" and I will not contact you again. [postal address]
cadence: Call. If no answer, leave the voicemail, then send the WhatsApp or email above.
Different angle: one useful tip about her Google listing or tap-to-call, with a screenshot. Check the signed-in listing first.
Proof: a short example from the portfolio, plus the Starter plan in two lines. Try the call at a different time of day.
Last message: "I'll leave it here. The free check is open whenever you want it." Then stop.
Move to the booked 15-minute check. Update the CRM and correct this brief.
compliance: Record the lead source, date and what the form said about contact (a person checks the form wording).
Check her number against TPS before calling, and the consent for email and WhatsApp (sole traders are treated like individuals for marketing messages; confirm the rule on the ICO site).
WhatsApp business messages outside 24 hours of her last message need an approved template (R: marketingskills sms/whatsapp notes).
If she says stop, stop on every channel and log it.
